title: ever SAUYER|Strapless Pleated V-Neck A-Line Maxi Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Strapless V-Neck A-Line Floor-Length Asymmetrical Bridesmaid Dress! This stunning gown features a chic strapless design that beautifully highlights your shoulders and neckline. The flattering A-line silhouette creates a graceful flow, while the asymmetrical hem adds a contemporary twist. Crafted from high-quality fabric, this dress ensures comfort and movement as you celebrate all night long. Perfect for weddings, receptions, or any formal occasion, this versatile piece will make you and your bridal party shine.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded enough for "no bra" option, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
